folder.description: Parent directory. In a Notebook, use a notebook-relative ordinary folder path; omit to create at the Notebook root. In source-repository mode this retains the legacy canvas grouping behavior. Artifact folders cannot contain canvases.

parentPath.description: Notebook-relative ordinary parent directory; omit to create at the Notebook root. Preferred creation-context field; folder remains accepted for compatibility.

folderKind.description: Legacy source-repository grouping only. Ignored for new Notebook Canvas artifacts.
